summary: Analyzed the owner's 2-page Senior Frontend CV against Finative's Senior Frontend Developer (Web) banking JD. Strong alignment: 6+ years, banking/fintech/e-commerce, React/TypeScript, Micro-Frontend, REST, enterprise performance/security/testing. Main evidence/keyword gaps: GraphQL, WebSockets, explicit caching/lazy loading/preloading, named UI/UX/prototyping tools. Recommended ATS-safe targeted rewrites, de-emphasizing AI-specific content, clarifying English wording and location/employment details, and only adding missing technologies when genuinely used.
